test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a decision followed by two statements I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option.

**Decision:**

The management of an international school P has requested all students and their parents to consider carpooling for travelling to school and minimise individual vehicles.

**Statements:**

I. Since most students use individual vehicles, traffic has been an increasing problem since the last few months.

II. The locality in which school P is located has reported three instances of car theft around midnight in the last four months.

options.text: Statement I strengthens the decision but statement II is neutral.
Statement I is neutral but statement II strengthens the decision.
Statement I weakens the decision but statement II strengthens the decision.
Both statements I and II weaken the decision.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Statement I strengthens the decision but statement II is neutral.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Statement I **strengthens** the decision as it provides a reason for the** management's request **to consider carpooling.
 
• If most students use individual vehicles, it can lead to** traffic congestion, **which can be reduced by carpooling.
 
• Statement II i**s neutral** as it **does not **directly relate to the decision of carpooling. 
 
• However, it can indirectly support the decision as carpooling can **reduce the number of cars parked **in the locality, which can minimize the risk of car theft.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carpooling **is a practice of **sharing a car journey** so that more than one person travels in a car.
 
• In addition to being a cost-effective mode of transportation, carpooling has other **environmental advantages.**
 
• When more people ride together, there are fewer cars on the road and **less dangerous pollutants** are released into the air.
 
• **Car theft** is a criminal act of **stealing a car.**
